```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Data loading
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Setting the plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot grouped by 'KreisLang' and 'Rasse1Text'
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='Rasse1Text', palette='viridis')

# Adding title and labels
ax.set_title("Number of Dogs by District and Breed", fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel("District", fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Dogs", fontsize=12)

# Adding legend
ax.legend(title='Breed', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig("output.png", bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
```
